title: pascalorg/editor brings agent-assisted workflows to architectural design
friendlyTitle: An open 3D building editor that AI agents can use
summary: Pascal is an open-source 3D architectural editor with a local CLI, MCP tools, and packaged integrations for several agent hosts. Its 1.0 release combines visual editing with machine-readable commands and capture workflows.
friendlySummary: Pascal combines a visual architecture editor with command-line and MCP tools for AI agents. People can still see and edit the design directly.
whyItMatters: Architects and developers can use it to create and inspect spatial designs while letting an agent operate through explicit tools rather than screen guessing alone. The local CLI and MCP surface also make design actions easier to script, review, and repeat.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to explore building designs with an agent while keeping the work visible and repeatable.
